verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as periodic mail forwarding or check-deposit runs, is a fair capability to ask of a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only API integrations, AI auto-labeling and junk filtering, which are event-driven or adjacent features rather than recurring scheduled workflows. Nothing documents a scheduler or recurring jobs.
